title: Partnership distributions — Dalia and Emre
instructions: Compute the results of two distributions from Harbor Partners (no §751 issues unless stated, no marketable securities).

exhibits.title: Dalia — current distribution
exhibits.content: Outside basis before the distribution: **$50,000**. She receives cash **$10,000**, inventory (partnership basis **$15,000**; FMV **$20,000**) and land (partnership basis **$40,000**; FMV **$60,000**).

exhibits.title: Emre — liquidating distribution
exhibits.content: Outside basis: **$80,000**. He receives cash **$30,000** and inventory (partnership basis **$20,000**) in complete liquidation.

parts.prompt: Compute the following (enter losses as positive amounts).

rows.label: Dalia's outside basis after the distribution
Emre's recognized loss
rows.explanation: Only cash and inventory: 80,000 − 30,000 − 20,000 = **30,000** capital loss.

rows.label: If Dalia sells the inventory within 5 years, is the gain ordinary?
rows.explanation: Distributed inventory keeps its ordinary character for 5 years.
